prompts: Create TWO complete separate animation source parts for exactly the lantern-keeper in the supplied approved reference, on a genuinely transparent canvas, side by side with clear empty space. This is production part artwork, not a new character or pose sheet. Left part: the animal's complete compact FOREST-BLUE-GREEN FUR TORSO only, with the actual ivory flank streaks that are visible above the rear thigh in the reference. Fill its hidden front shoulder, neck socket and closed rounded underside. Remove the entire head, both huge ears, amber gems, ALL chest mane/ruff, ALL legs and paws, ALL round spiral thighs, and the tail. In particular no ivory chest leaves, no standing limb-shaped protrusions, no giant thigh C or whorl may remain baked into the torso. The torso is a low rounded oval with a smooth closed front shoulder and underside, preserving the original coat palette, fur brush size, soft volume and three-quarter camera. Right part: the complete dense IVORY LEAF-LIKE CHEST RUFF of the same reference as its own continuous soft part, including a short hidden root cap at its upper attachment. It is a short broad overlapping cluster of fur tufts tapering down the chest, not a long beard or extra white foreleg. Remove face, eyes, nose, ears, amber gem and all paws from it. Keep original painterly lighting, cream fur shading, forest green recesses and distinctive broad fur tufts. Neither part contains any detached scraps, dark background haze, cast ground shadow, text, labels or guides. Both must be complete closed painted silhouettes suitable for bending or rotating independently. Use large parts and preserve their anatomical proportion to one another. The supplied original is the only design authority.

Edit the LEFT torso source part in this two-part image. Remove the ENTIRE large round C-striped rear thigh bulge that is attached to the torso's lower RIGHT side. That circular dark-green center and both cream crescent stripes are a LEG and must disappear completely, not be repainted as a different spiral. Reconstruct the smooth CLOSED underlying dark forest-green torso where this whole leg was attached. The resulting torso is one low compact oval, not two lobes, with no legs, paws, haunch, round disc, spiral, chest mane or tail. Keep the torso's existing small upper ivory flank streak but no large lower-right concentric C motif. Retain painted fur texture, green palette, original scale and lighting. Preserve the separate right-hand ivory chest ruff unchanged. Transparent background. No text, no annotations. These are complete practical source layers for a character rig.
